answer_1.quote: LLaMP supports a wide range of advanced capabilities, including multi-modal searching, tensor and 3D crystal structure retrieval and operation, and language-driven simulation.
answer_1.outputs: The framework generates material property predictions, synthesis procedures, crystal structures, and simulation workflows based on natural language instructions.

answer_2.quote: We define the following metrics: Precision. (sample standard deviation) measures the uncertainty in the model's responses... Coefficient of Precision (CoP)... Confidence... Self-consistency of Response (SCoR)... Mean Absolute Error (MAE).
